avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra (Ma Huang)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct sympathomimetic activity opposes beta-blocker effects; risk of hypertensive crisis and arrhythmias
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid all ephedra-containing products

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-2 adrenergic antagonist increases sympathetic activity, counteracting metoprolol's therapeutic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor blood pressure and heart rate if patient insists on use

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer reduces metoprolol plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Counsel avoidance; if discontinued, monitor for metoprolol toxicity as levels may rise

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: May cause sodium retention and fluid accumulation, potentially increasing blood pressure despite metoprolol use
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously and monitor blood pressure; limit to short-term use

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild sympathomimetic properties and could slightly reduce antihypertensive efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure if used; counsel moderation and inform healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Caffeine supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic stimulant may partially counteract beta-blocker effects on heart rate and blood pressure
caution_supplements.action: Recommend limiting caffeine intake; monitor heart rate and blood pressure response

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases metoprolol bioavailability and plasma concentrations, elevating risk of bradycardia and hypotension
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit products entirely; patient should select alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium intake may counteract blood pressure-lowering effects and increase fluid retention
caution_foods.action: Counsel on sodium restriction consistent with cardiovascular recommendations (<2,300 mg/day)

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-rich beverages (coffee, tea, energy drinks)
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine stimulates sympathetic nervous system; may reduce antihypertensive and heart rate-lowering effects
caution_foods.action: Recommend moderation (≤200 mg/day); monitor heart rate and blood pressure response

monitoring_notes: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and signs of decompensated heart failure at each visit; assess adherence and educate on avoiding sudden discontinuation. Counsel patients on CYP2D6-sensitive interactions, particularly with other cardioactive or CNS-active medications, and reinforce importance of disclosing all supplements.
